chunks: And Dāwūd ibn al-Ḥuṣayn narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Breastfeeding after two years, before the child is weaned, establishes prohibition.

key_terms.الرَّضَاعُ: breastfeeding or suckling that may establish milk-kinship
key_terms.حَوْلَيْنِ: two lunar years as the relevant legal period
key_terms.يُحَرِّمُ: it establishes prohibition for marriage through milk-kinship
key_terms.يُفْطَمَ: the child is weaned from breastfeeding

ai.seo_question: Does breastfeeding after two years establish milk-kinship prohibition in Islamic law?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the effect of breastfeeding on establishing milk-kinship prohibition. It links the ruling to the period of two years and the state before weaning, showing the juridical importance of timing in breastfeeding relations.
